codeReview.summary: Re-verification of the two blocking foh-setup-ui findings against the fix commit 275d4b30 (feature foh-core-fix-ui, setup half). FINDING 1 (floor-plan failed save cleared the dirty flag) is RESOLVED. `handleSave` is now `(draft) => Promise<boolean>`: it returns false when there is no write access or location (settings.floor-plan.tsx:81) and false in the catch that covers 409 and every other error (:96-108), and true only after the write, the refetch and the summary refresh all succeed (:95). The canvas awaits the result (floor-plan-canvas.tsx:598-634) and calls `setDirty(false)` only when it is true (:635). Consequently, after a 409/5xx save the draft stays dirty: the header keeps the 'Unsaved draft changes' badge (:664-670) instead of 'Saved' (:671-675), the Discard draft button stays (:693-704), 'Leave without saving' still opens the confirmation banner (:385-391, :730-758), and the baseline-sync effect stays skipped because it is guarded by `if (!dirty)` (:162-180), so the route's 409/stale-version banner cannot silently replace the local draft. 'Reload latest floor plan' now discards the draft explicitly before refetching (:784-787), which is what makes the fresh baseline apply; Discard is unchanged (:370-383). New component tests cover both directions (floor-plan-canvas.test.tsx:233-262 failed save keeps the Discard button, :264-290 successful save removes it) and I ran the file at HEAD: 5/5 pass. FINDING 2 (hardcoded English labels under ?lng=ar) is RESOLVED for every enumerated control: WEEKDAY_OPTIONS now holds MessageDescriptors plus a stable `code` used only for test ids (setup-api.ts:342-390), rendered with `_(day.shortLabel)` (settings.services.tsx:664) and `formatDaysOfWeek(svc.daysOfWeek, _)` (:777); 'Every day' goes through `translate(msg`Every day`)` (:94). SHAPE_OPTIONS uses msg descriptors (settings.tables.tsx:61-70), rendered at :875-877 and via shapeLabel() at :1005. The canvas TABLE_SHAPES (:75-86) and ELEMENT_KINDS (:87-104) render `_(kind.label)` / `_(s.label)` (:880-882, :1180-1182), and the two previously-raw aria-labels are now Lingui messages (:987-989, :1064-1066). Special-days badges use SPECIAL_DAY_KIND_LABELS (:68-73) and BLOCK_REASON_LABELS (:75-82) at :765-766 and :1041-1042; the availability-mode badge uses AVAILABILITY_MODE_LABELS (settings.services.tsx:82-87, rendered :1431-1435); section colour names are Lingui descriptors (settings.sections.tsx:62-71, rendered :453-461); every canvas live announcement and nudge/drag announcement is wrapped (callers at floor-plan-canvas.tsx:317-319, :345-347, :356, :367, :382, :426-428, :542, :550, :568, :576). ar.po spot-checks for all of these msgids have non-empty Arabic msgstr (e.g. 'Every day' -> 'كل يوم', 'High-top' -> 'طاولة مرتفعة', 'Closed (all day)' -> 'مغلق (طوال اليوم)', '1 · Blue' -> '1 · أزرق', 'All channels' -> 'جميع القنوات', 'Element {elementName} ({elementX}, {elementY})' -> Arabic with Arabic comma), and the only empty msgstr in ar.po is the file header's `msgid ""`. ADJUDICATION of the save-succeeded/refetch-failed path, from the code: (a) After a successful PUT, `fetchFloorPlan` at settings.floor-plan.tsx:90 throws (it is the only throw source left: `refreshSummary` swallows its own errors at settings.tsx:153-179, so it can never throw). Control jumps to the catch at :96; `isVersionConflictError` is false for a GET failure, so the generic branch sets errorMessage (:104-106) and handleSave returns false (:108). The canvas therefore keeps dirty = true (setDirty(false) at :635 is skipped), shows the 'Unsaved draft changes' badge, keeps Discard and the Leave confirmation, and does not overwrite the draft. The route renders the error banner 'Failed to save floor plan.' (:159-167, testid floor-plan-save-error) and savedBanner stays null because it is only set at :93, after the refetch - so the UI reports a failure although the write persisted. (b) The route's `floorPlan` state is never updated (setFloorPlan at :91 never ran), so the canvas keeps the stale `floorPlanVersion` prop (:181). The next Save sends that already-consumed version (floor-plan-canvas.tsx:599), and the backend rejects any mismatch with 409 stale_version (rsv-setup-crud.ts:1437-1449). So after further edits a plain re-save cannot succeed; the operator must click 'Reload latest floor plan' (:784-787, clears dirty and refetches) or reload the page. Note the PUT response already carries the new version (rsv-setup-crud.ts:1818-1824, normalized at setup-api.ts:1331), so the refetch dependency is avoidable. (c) VAL-SETUP-011 is not broken: the write did return 200, bumped rsv_location_settings.floor_plan_version (rsv-setup-crud.ts:1795-1798) and wrote the floor_plan.save audit row (rsv-setup-crud.ts:1803-1810), which are exactly the contract's evidence; the persisted work is what a full reload shows (remount -> loadFloorPlan GET -> saved state), and further edits are saveable after the explicit reload. The residual harm is a misleading failure banner plus a stale expected version that 409s the next save until reload - recoverable, with no silent data loss (the only discard is the explicitly labelled 'Reload latest' click). No new defects or regressions were introduced by the fix in the setup scope: the only behavioural test-id change (setup-service-day-${day.code}) is byte-identical in English and referenced by no test, and the failed-save path is now strictly safer than before. Non-blocking residue recorded as issues: raw enum renders of the same class as finding 2 that the enumerated finding did not list (pacing channel cell, General-tab issue.code / conflict.reason badges), and a pre-existing App/API pacing-channel mismatch. Minor cleanup noted, not an issue: WEEKDAY_OPTIONS.fullLabel is now read nowhere (setup-api.ts:347-389).

issues.description: False-negative save result when the write succeeds but the post-save refetch fails. `handleSave` treats `fetchFloorPlan` (line 90) and `refreshSummary` (line 94) as part of the save; `refreshSummary` cannot throw (settings.tsx:153-179 catches internally), so a failed GET at line 90 lands in the catch (:96-108), sets 'Failed to save floor plan.' and returns false even though the PUT persisted. The canvas then keeps dirty = true and the stale `floorPlanVersion` prop (the route never ran setFloorPlan at :91), so the next Save sends the consumed version and the backend answers 409 stale_version (rsv-setup-crud.ts:1437-1449) until the operator clicks 'Reload latest floor plan'. Facts for the adjudication are in codeReview.summary (a/b/c): the persisted work is correct after a reload and VAL-SETUP-011's required 200 + incremented floorPlanVersion + floor_plan.save audit are all satisfied; the defect is the misleading failure state plus the forced reload before re-saving. Suggested fix: treat the write itself as the success signal and use the version already returned by the PUT (rsv-setup-crud.ts:1818-1824 -> setup-api.ts:1331), handling refetch errors separately (the worker recorded the same issue as non_blocking in the handoff).

Residual i18n gap of the same class as blocking finding 2, outside the enumerated list: the Pacing Rules table renders the raw channel enum as cell text, `{rule.channel ?? 'all'}` (values all/online/phone/walk_in per setup-api.ts:200), while the sibling select options are localized at :1178-1185 ('All channels', 'Online only', 'Phone only', 'Walk-in only'). Under ?lng=ar the table shows 'all'/'online' in English. Not part of the round-1 finding (which named weekday chips, shape/element options and the special-day kind/block-reason badges) nor of the fix feature's description, so the fix's declared scope is met; recorded so the residual is visible.

Residual raw enum badges in the General tab, same class as the fixed special-days badges: `<Badge variant="outline">{issue.code}</Badge>` (line 820, validation codes such as invalid_interval_min / combination_duplicate_members from packages/reservations/src/config/validate.ts) and `<Badge variant="secondary">{conflict.reason}</Badge>` (line 874, SetupConflictDto reasons such as table_capacity_reduced / special_day_closed, setup-api.ts:132-141). Both render English codes under ?lng=ar. Pre-existing and not enumerated in the round-1 finding or the fix description; noted for a follow-up rather than as a fix defect.

Pre-existing (present before this fix; the fix commit did not touch these lines) App/API mismatch in the Pacing Rules form: the select offers 'Phone only' and 'Walk-in only' (settings.services.tsx:1183-1184) and the App type allows them (setup-api.ts:200), but the tenant-api validates `channel` with `z.enum(['all','online'])` (packages/reservations/src/schemas/setup.ts:266, used by the pacing create/update handlers at operator-reservations-setup.ts:1395/1418) and VAL-SETUP-020 specifies `channel` ('all' or 'online'). Choosing either extra option therefore fails with a 400 from the API. Out of scope for this fix, flagged as a concrete failure path discovered while reviewing the setup screens.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worth recording as a reusable pattern for explicit-Save editors: use the write response as the success signal instead of a follow-up refetch. The floor-plan PUT already returns the new floorPlanVersion, but the route refetches and treats a failed refetch as a failed save, which yields a false failure banner and a stale expectedFloorPlanVersion that 409s the next save until the operator reloads. A short note ('onSave must resolve on the write, not on the refetch; read the new version from the PUT response') would prevent the next editor from copying the coupling.

summary: Fix re-review for the setup half of foh-core-fix-ui (commit 275d4b30, repo /home/factory-user/repos/menuza, branch pr/reservations). Both round-1 blocking findings against foh-setup-ui are resolved in the current code. (1) A failed floor-plan save now keeps the local draft dirty: handleSave returns Promise<boolean> with false on every error path (settings.floor-plan.tsx:81, :108) and true only after save + refetch (settings.floor-plan.tsx:95), and the canvas clears dirty only when it receives true (floor-plan-canvas.tsx:635), so the 'Unsaved draft changes' badge, the Discard button, the Leave-without-saving confirmation and the `if (!dirty)` baseline guard (floor-plan-canvas.tsx:162-180, :385-391, :664-704) all survive a 409/5xx; 'Reload latest floor plan' discards the draft explicitly (:784-787). New component tests cover both the failed and the successful save (floor-plan-canvas.test.tsx:233-290; the file passes 5/5 when I ran it at HEAD). (2) The enumerated hardcoded labels all go through Lingui now: weekday chips and 'Every day' (setup-api.ts:342-390, settings.services.tsx:94, :664, :777), table shapes (settings.tables.tsx:61-70, :875-877, :1005), canvas element/table shapes and the two previously-raw aria-labels (floor-plan-canvas.tsx:75-104, :880-882, :987-989, :1064-1066, :1180-1182), special-day kind and block-reason badges (settings.special-days.tsx:68-82, :765-766, :1041-1042), plus the availability-mode badge and section colours; ar.po has real Arabic for every spot-checked msgid and no empty msgstr besides the header. Adjudication of the worker-reported save/refetch coupling, with file:line evidence: (a) a successful PUT followed by a failed fetchFloorPlan lands in the catch, sets the generic 'Failed to save floor plan.' banner and returns false, leaving dirty = true (badge, Discard, Leave prompt and draft all preserved); refreshSummary cannot throw, so the GET is the only failure point; (b) the route's floorPlan state is not updated, so the canvas keeps the stale floorPlanVersion and the next Save sends the consumed version, which the backend rejects with 409 stale_version (rsv-setup-crud.ts:1437-1449) until the operator uses 'Reload latest floor plan' or reloads the page; (c) VAL-SETUP-011 is nonetheless satisfied - the PUT returned 200, bumped floor_plan_version and wrote floor_plan.save (rsv-setup-crud.ts:1795-1810), the persisted work is what a reload shows, and the only data loss is the explicitly labelled reload/discard. No new defect or regression found in the setup scope. Non-blocking residue: raw enum renders of the same class that the enumerated finding did not list (settings.services.tsx:1239 pacing channel cell; settings._index.tsx:820/874 validation-code and conflict-reason badges), a pre-existing App/API pacing-channel mismatch (setup-api.ts:200 vs schemas/setup.ts:266 vs VAL-SETUP-020), and the now-unused WEEKDAY_OPTIONS.fullLabel. Shared-state notes cover the now-stale foh-core findings block in library/app-ui-patterns.md, a sharper grep rule for raw `{enum}` renders, the skipped ?lng=ar browser pass, and a reusable 'onSave resolves on the write, not the refetch' note. Status: pass.
